title: Revenge of the CATS!
description: If you kill a cat you die, It's what you deserve...
body:
People are killing cats on your minecraft server? Well i have the solution for you! Install this pack to you minecraft server and people will have to pay for killing cats with their life. I mean i think they deserve it...

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it:
